property_summary: For every caller address, calling owned() on the reference contract never succeeds in changing or revealing any state because only the owner can execute it (non-owners cannot make the call succeed); the mutant that removes the require allows a non-owner contract caller to execute owned() and thereby make observable differences (the test detects that a non-owner contract can successfully call owned() on the mutant but cannot on the reference).
change_summary: Delete the require check in onlyOwner modifier so owned() can be called by anyone, potentially changing owner via other mutations or exposures; this allows external callers to invoke owned() and observe differences if owned() mutates state (originally prevented).
